title: High-Energy Particle Physics
description: Colliders, quark-gluon plasma, strange matter and magnetic monopoles.

puzzle.goal: A charged particle of charge q flies through an electric field E⃗ and a magnetic field B⃗ at velocity v⃗. Write the rate of change of its relativistic momentum γmv⃗ as the sum of the electric push and the sideways magnetic push.
puzzle.name: Lorentz force law (relativistic)
puzzle.lhs: d ( γ * m * vec ( v ) , t )
puzzle.form: q * vec ( E ) + q * vec ( v ) × vec ( B )
puzzle.ask: In a pure magnetic field the momentum turns on a circle of radius R = p/(qB); for a unit charge with p in GeV/c and B in tesla this is R = p / (0.3 B) metres. Find R for p = @{p} GeV/c protons in an 8.33 T dipole.
puzzle.method: The electric force is qE⃗; the magnetic force is the charge times the cross product of velocity with the field.
